scope: Replay encoder job lifecycle plus native replay-header and output-descriptor ownership

applied.name: ReplayEncoderContext_Reset
applied.evidence: Requests termination of an active replay job, pumps it to terminal state 7, destroys it, and resets the embedded 0x2C-byte output descriptor, 0xAE0-byte header, and lifecycle fields.

applied.name: ReplayEncoderContext_Dtor
applied.evidence: Resets the complete 0xB24-byte encoder context and dispatches the embedded header and output-descriptor destructors.

applied.name: ReplayJobHandle_SetIfEmpty
applied.evidence: Stores a replay job pointer only when the handle is currently null and returns the resulting handle.

applied.name: KWReplayHeader_Ctor
applied.evidence: Zero-initializes the complete 0xAE0-byte native replay header.

applied.name: KWReplayHeader_Reset
applied.evidence: Frees the optional owned metadata buffer at offsets 0xAD8/0xADC and zeroes the complete 0xAE0-byte replay header.

applied.name: ReplayOutputDescriptor_Reset
applied.evidence: Frees all three owned path/endpoint strings and zeroes the complete 0x2C-byte replay output descriptor.

applied.name: KWReplayHeader_CopyAssign
applied.evidence: Resets the destination, copies the fixed 0xAE0-byte header, and deep-copies the optional metadata payload.

applied.name: KWReplayHeader_Dtor
applied.evidence: Destructor thunk that releases owned replay-header metadata and clears the header.

applied.name: ReplayOutputDescriptor_Dtor
applied.evidence: Destructor thunk that releases owned output-descriptor strings.

applied.name: KWReplayJob_RequestStop
applied.evidence: Transitions the replay job toward terminal state with reason 1 and immediate transport shutdown. This corrects a false CRT _exit FLIRT match; the function returns normally and is not noreturn.
